scoring_justification: Dispersion is recomputed from the agent’s q-points using Eq. 10‑11 with paper‑reported T=0 σ; magnetization is compared to paper‑gold σ(T) points; Néel temperature is compared to paper‑gold Tc values within ±5 %. These constitute T1 recompute for the main quantities.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold σ values for dispersion and magnetization, and paper‑gold Tc values for required Néel‑temperature cases.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: σ=0.37 (symmetric Ba₂IrO₄) stated on p.3; σ=0.44 (large anisotropic) stated on p.4; σ=0.36 (NNN model) stated on p.6. Magnetization gold points estimated from Fig. 3 of the paper. Tc=0.365 J = 275 K for symmetric case (p.5) and Tc=0.3 J = 220 K for NNN model (Appendix).
hidden_assets.generation_method: σ values taken verbatim from the paper text; magnetization σ(T) points read from Fig. 3 using digitisation; Tc values taken from the paper’s explicit statements.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All numbers are extracted directly from the paper’s own quantitative results; they are not invented.

outputs.description: JSON file containing the RPA spin-wave dispersion for the symmetric compass model (J=65 meV, Jz=0, Γx=Γy=3.4 meV, σ=0.37), the sublattice magnetization σ(T) for the symmetric Ba₂IrO₄ case (J=65 meV, Jz=5e-5 J, Γx=Γy=3.4 meV) with T in units of J, and the Néel temperatures for two required cases: symmetric_Ba2IrO4 and NNN_model. The checker recomputes dispersion at the provided q-points, compares magnetization at selected temperatures, and verifies TN against hidden paper values.

output_contract.notes: All quantities must be computed from the given model parameters using the RPA Green's function formalism. The q-point path must follow Γ→X→M→Γ in the square lattice with qz=0. Temperatures in magnetization_curve must be dimensionless T/J. The keys in neel_temperatures are exact: 'symmetric_Ba2IrO4' and 'NNN_model'. Other keys may be present but will not be scored.

steps.description: Recompute spin‑wave dispersion from the submitted q‑points using Eq. 10‑11 with the paper‑reported T=0 σ (0.37). Tolerance ±3 meV.
Compare sublattice magnetization σ at selected temperatures (in units of J) against paper‑gold values, tolerance ±0.02.
Compare reported Tc_meV for the required cases against paper‑gold values (0.365 J ≈ 23.7 meV for symmetric Ba₂IrO₄, 0.3 J ≈ 19.5 meV for NNN model), tolerance ±5 %.
